WPT|/rc.m3d.co/rcwall/2/1: {IC} in two coats into the matt damp concrete, 1.5 kg/m² for pressing water: the crystals grow into the capillaries and hold negative pressing water up to 1.5 bar. Kept damp ≥ 3 days, ventilated, no condensation.

WPT|/rc.m3d.co/rcpit/2/1: Two coats of {IC} over walls and floor into the matt damp concrete; kept damp ≥ 3 days; deep pits are ventilated for 24 hours and the dew point avoided with dryers, never with direct heating.
WPT|/rc.m3d.co/rcsew/0/1: Aggressive or soft water (hardness < 30 mg CaO per litre) always requires a water analysis; the degree of attack is evaluated in accordance with EN 1992-1-1. Sludge and biofilm are jetted off; cracks are chased and filled with {IM}.

WPT|/rc.m3d.co/rcsew/2/1: Kept damp for ≥ 3 days at a constant relative humidity > 80 %; in service water tanks at 10–15 °C seven days are generally sufficient. Filling after 3 days; the slurry cannot be overcoated with tiles, plaster or paint.

WPT|/ca.title: Crystalline concrete admixture
WPT|/ca.sub: Watertight concrete from the mixer: the waterproofing is in the mix from day one.
WPT|/ca.intro: The crystalline admixture is dosed into the fresh concrete — liquid with the mixing water ({CL170}, {CL210}) or as a powder onto the aggregates ({CP360}, {CP350}) — and hardens with it. When water reaches the hardened concrete the active ingredient dissolves, reacts with the calcium hydroxide of the cement and grows insoluble crystals in the capillary pores and in cracks: the component itself becomes the waterproofing. No membrane, no separate site trade, no renewal cycle; cracks up to 0.4 mm heal themselves for the life of the structure.
WPT|/ca.photoCap: The effect in the section of a wall under water pressure: the denser matrix moves the capillary zone outwards, so water, chlorides and carbon dioxide stay away from the reinforcement. Switch between the reference concrete and the concrete with BETOCRETE.

WPT|/ca.adv.label: Advantages
WPT|/ca.adv.title: Why the system works
WPT|/ca.adv.cards/0/3: Surface and continuous cracks up to 0.4 mm (tapering down to 0.5 mm) are healed by crystal growth whenever water reaches them — accelerated and increased against untreated concrete, for the life of the component.
WPT|/ca.adv.cards/1/2: Less water from the first day
WPT|/ca.adv.cards/1/3: The sealant integrated in {CL210} and {CP360} (DIN EN 934-2, Table 9) makes the hardened concrete hydrophobic at once: the capillary water absorption falls by more than half before the first crystal has grown.
WPT|/ca.adv.cards/2/3: Reduced chloride ion migration, lower carbonation speed ({CL210}, {CP360}), improved resistance to frost and freeze–thaw: less water carries fewer aggressive substances into the concrete and to the reinforcement.
WPT|/ca.adv.cards/3/2: A longer life for the component
WPT|/ca.adv.cards/3/3: By the BAW method — service life from the chloride migration coefficient and the concrete cover — a test report shows a 2.5-fold service life of the BETOCRETE concrete against the reference recipe.
WPT|/ca.adv.cards/4/3: {CL170} is a concrete plasticiser (DIN EN 934-2, Table 2) with crystalline effect: water saving up to 10 %, a lower w/c ratio, a smoother consistency — dosed with the mixing water in the plant.
WPT|/ca.adv.cards/5/3: {CP350} combines the crystalline effect with a corrosion inhibitor: reduced capillary absorption and chloride migration keep the steel passive. Suitable for drinking water (DVGW W 270 / W 347).
WPT|/ca.pictos/0/2: two liquids for the dosing system of the plant, two powders for the mixer and the water-soluble bag of the truck
WPT|/ca.pictos/1/2: CE after DIN EN 934-2 with Declaration of Performance; BBA certificates; DVGW worksheets W 270 and W 347; test reports on crack healing, chloride migration, water penetration, freeze–thaw–salt and carbonation
WPT|/ca.pictos/2/2: no protection layer, no seams, no adhesion, no excavation for repair: the waterproofing is the concrete
